## Loading the packages


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, tmap, tidyverse, sfdep)
```
:::


## Importing Hunan shapefile and GDP table

Import Hunan shapefile


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
                 layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

  `C:\hungthq\ISSS626-GAA\In-class_Ex\In-class_Ex05\data\geospatial' 
  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
Simple feature collection with 88 features and 7 fields
Geometry type: POLYGON
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 108.7831 ymin: 24.6342 xmax: 114.2544 ymax: 30.12812

```


:::
:::


Import Hunan GDP file:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::


Join Hunan & Hunan2012 data.frames and tidy the data table by retaining NAME_2, ID_3, NAME_3, County, GDPPC, GIO, Agri and Service


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_GDPPC_ <- left_join(hunan,hunan2012)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_GDPPC <- hunan_GDPPC_ %>%
  select(1:3, 7, 15, 16, 33)
```
:::


Plotting choropleth map


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(hunan_GDPPC) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "GDPPC", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile", 
                values = "brewer.blues")) +
  tm_title("Distribution of GDP per capita by county, Hunan Province", 2.0, "dark blue") +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(fill_alpha =0.2) +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c("left", "bottom"),
            legend.text.size = 1.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=960}
:::
:::


## Global mearuse of Spatial Association

**Step1: deriving Queen's contiguity weights: sfdep methods**


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wm_q <- hunan_GDPPC %>%
  mutate (nb= st_contiguity(geometry),
          wt= st_weights(nb, style = "W"),
          .before=1)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
names(wm_q)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
 [1] "nb"       "wt"       "NAME_2"   "ID_3"     "NAME_3"   "County"  
 [7] "GDPPC"    "GIO"      "Disp_Inc" "geometry"
```


:::
:::


**Step2: computing Global Moran's I**


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
moranI <- global_moran(wm_q$GDPPC,
                       wm_q$nb,
                       wm_q$wt)

glimpse(moranI)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
List of 2
 $ I: num 0.301
 $ K: num 7.64
```


:::
:::


**Computing Local Moran's I**


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lisa <- wm_q %>%
  mutate(local_moran = local_moran(
    GDPPC, nb, wt, nsim = 99),
    .before =1) %>%
  unnest(local_moran)
```
:::


Visualising local Moran's I


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(lisa) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "ii",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "fixed", 
                breaks = c(
                  -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
                values = "brewer.rd_bu"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local Moran's I")) + 
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_view(set_zoom_limits = c(6,8)) + 
  tm_title("local Moran's I of GDPPC", 2.0) +
  tm_layout(legend.text.size = 1.2,
            legend.position = c('left', 'bottom'))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=960}
:::
:::


Visualising p-value of local Moran's I


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(lisa) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "p_ii_sim") +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("p-value of local Moran's I", 2.0) +
  tm_layout(legend.title.size = 1.5,
            legend.position = c('left', 'bottom'))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=960}
:::
:::


**Visualising local Moran's I and p-value**

Plotting both maps for better comparision


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
local_gdppc <- tm_shape(lisa) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "ii",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "fixed", 
                breaks = c(
                  -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
                values = "brewer.rd_bu"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Local Moran's I")) +

  tm_view(set_zoom_limits = c(6,8)) +

local_pvalue <- tm_shape(lisa) +
```

## LISA map

LISA map is a categorical map showing **outliers** and **clusters**. There are two types of outliers namely: High-Low and Low-High outliers. Likewise, there are two type of clusters namely: High-High and Low-Low cluaters. In fact, LISA map is an interpreted map by combining local Moran’s I of geographical areas and their respective p-values.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lisa_sig <- lisa %>%
  filter(p_ii_sim < 0.05)
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(lisa) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha=0.5) +
tm_shape(lisa_sig) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "mean",
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                text.size = 1.15,
                width =6
              )) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.4) +
  tm_layout(legend.title.size = 1.25,
            legend.position = c('left', 'bottom'))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=768}
:::
:::


**Hot spot and cold spot area analysis (HCSA)**

- HCSA uses spatial weights to identify locations of statistically significant hot spots and cold spots in an spatially weighted attribute that are in proximity to one another based on a calculated distance.

- The analysis groups features when similar high (hot) or low (cold) values are found in a cluster. The polygon features usually represent administration boundaries or a custom grid structure.

Computing local Gi\* statistics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wm_idw <- hunan_GDPPC %>%
  mutate(nb = include_self(
    st_contiguity(geometry)),
    wts = st_inverse_distance(nb, 
                              geometry, 
                              scale = 1,
                              alpha = 1),
    .before = 1)
```
:::


Computing local Gi\* statistics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
HCSA <- wm_idw %>% 
  mutate(local_Gi = local_gstar_perm(
    GDPPC, nb, wts, nsim = 99),
    .before = 1) %>%
  unnest(local_Gi)
```
:::


Visualising Gi\*


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(HCSA) +
  tm_fill("gi_star") + 
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_view(set.zoom.limits = c(6,8)) +
  tm_title(
    "local G*i for GDP per capita", 2.0) +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c('left', 'bottom'))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-17-1.png){width=768}
:::
:::


Visualising p-value of local G\*i


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(HCSA) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "p_sim",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      breaks = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1.0),
      labels = c("p < 0.001", "p < 0.01", "p < 0.05", "Not Significant"),
      values = c("#de2d26", "#fc9272", "#fee0d2", "#e0e0e0")),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "p-values")
  ) + 
  tm_title("p-values of G*i for GDP per capita") +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_layout(legend.position = c('left', 'bottom'),
            legend.text.size = 1.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-18-1.png){width=768}
:::
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
      values = c("#de2d26", "#fc9272", "#fee0d2", "#e0e0e0")),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "p-values")
  ) + 
  tm_title("p-values of G*i for GDP per capita") +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +

tmap_arrange(localGstari,pvalueGstari )
```

::: {.cell}
